tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide ground. Every slide starts white; tints sit on it as cards, never as full-bleed backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-mint
tokens.usage: Default card tint: step stacks, tile grids, timeline cells. Ground for ink, ink-muted, forest-700, teal-700.

tokens.name: surface-sky
tokens.usage: Problem card and 'at submission' cells. Ground for ink, ink-navy, teal-700.

tokens.name: surface-sand
tokens.usage: Caution and 'expected / optional' cells; the FAIR-is-not-open note. Ground for ink, amber-900.

tokens.name: surface-lilac
tokens.usage: Single-cell / plum-coded cards and 'future direction' notes. Ground for ink, plum-700.

tokens.name: surface-gray
tokens.usage: 'Not specified' cells, neutral process steps, licence tiles. Ground for ink, slate.

tokens.name: surface-gray-soft
tokens.usage: Inactive step boxes and table zebra rows. Ground for ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink-display
tokens.usage: Slide titles, section titles and card titles in the display face, on surface and every tint (10.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface and every tint.

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: Table body text and figure labels; solid fill for the dark 'human domain knowledge' hub and matrix header rows (on-dark text on it).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, captions, legend labels on surface and tints (4.45:1 on amber-200 is the one near-miss: keep muted text off amber-200).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Decorative only: hairline arrows, connector lines, 'desk rejection' side notes at 19px bold or larger. 3.7:1 on surface, so never for small body text.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Headings inside neutral gray tiles (licence names, review-model names) on surface-gray and surface.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside gray tiles; axis labels.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Primary accent: step-number discs, icon discs, 'why it matters' bars (on-dark text), active process step, kicker text on surface-sky. 5.4:1 on surface as text.

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: Cycle-diagram nodes and matrix 'mandatory' cells (on-dark text). 4.5:1 on surface: minimum for text, prefer teal-700.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Secondary matrix cells ('partly mandatory / deposit or justify') and arrow fills; ink-navy text on it.

tokens.name: teal-200
tokens.usage: Lightest teal cell; process-step chevrons at rest.

tokens.name: forest-700
tokens.usage: Forest accent: numbered discs on the 'AI path' slides, the hypothesis-driven route, result rows (on-dark text). 6.3:1 on surface as text.

tokens.name: forest-900
tokens.usage: Dark forest fill for the 'multi-scale landscape' summary slab and the PlantScience.ai card (on-dark text).

tokens.name: leaf-500
tokens.usage: Outcome accent: 'EMSAM result' disc, the big flow arrow. 3.7:1 on surface: fills and icons only, never small text.

tokens.name: leaf-300
tokens.usage: The large block arrow between a problem card and its step stack.

tokens.name: leaf-200
tokens.usage: Pale green cell for 'encouraged' matrix entries; ink text on it.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Caution accent: data-driven route boxes, 'single-anonymous' tiles, the growth curve. 3.1:1 on surface: fills, strokes and 24px+ headings only. Small amber text in the source deck ('Moving forward') fails 4.5:1; use amber-900 for that.

tokens.name: amber-600
tokens.usage: Numbered disc on the agents slide; dark amber 'why it matters' bar (on-dark text, 3.4:1: keep that bar's text 13px bold or larger).

tokens.name: amber-900
tokens.usage: Amber text that must be read: kickers and body on surface-sand (8.8:1).

tokens.name: amber-200
tokens.usage: Stronger sand cell for 'expected' matrix entries and the timeline 'moving forward' column; ink text on it.

tokens.name: plum-700
tokens.usage: Plum accent for the single-cell / transcriptomics modality: discs, kicker text on surface-lilac (6.7:1).

tokens.name: plum-500
tokens.usage: Lighter plum disc and stroke; 4.8:1 on surface as text at 13px+.

tokens.name: plum-200
tokens.usage: Plum cell tint for annotation and transfer rows.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: 'Not specified' legend chip and disabled chevrons. Fill only (3.1:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and table grid lines on surface and surface-mint.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and glyph icons on ink-navy, forest-700, forest-900, teal-700, teal-600, plum-700, amber-600 fills.

families.display: Cambria, "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: slide-title
styles.sample: AgroNT: scoring crop variants before the wet lab
styles.usage: One per slide, top-left, in ink-display. 26 pt in the deck. State the claim, not the topic.

styles.name: slide-title-long
styles.sample: Peer review vs. publication: when must data and code be shared?
styles.usage: Fallback when a claim-title would wrap to three lines at slide-title (21 pt in the deck).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Column heads and diagram titles (16 pt). Colour it with the column's accent (forest-700, amber-900, teal-700).

styles.name: card-title
styles.sample: What does noncoding DNA do, and which variants matter?
styles.usage: The question inside a ProblemCard and the 'Why it matters' lead-in (11 pt). ink-display.

styles.name: group-title
styles.usage: Sub-heading above a tile row (14 pt). ink-display.

styles.name: big-letter
styles.usage: Single letter or digit inside a 56px disc (FAIR tiles, stage numbers). on-dark on teal-700 / forest-700.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A headline number in a StatRow (28 pt). ink-display; the unit and label go in caption under it.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: All-caps context line above the slide title and inside cards ('THE PROBLEM', 'CLASSICAL ROUTE'). Coloured with the slide's accent; amber uses amber-900.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: From trusting the manuscript to verifying the evidence behind it.
styles.usage: One sentence under the title in ink-muted (9.5 pt). Says what the slide will show, in plain words.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Most plant genomes, especially orphan crops, lack functional annotation.
styles.usage: Bullets and step descriptions (9.5 pt). ink on any tint. Three lines max per bullet.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: far more candidate variants than can ever be tested
styles.usage: The one phrase per card you want read aloud. Bold inline, same colour as body.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Row label in a StepStack, column head in a Timeline (10.5 pt). ink-display or ink.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: 1-billion-parameter transformer trained by masked language modelling on ~10.5M sequences
styles.usage: Table cells, dense descriptions, legend text (8.5 pt). ink.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: SNV perturbation followed by wet-lab validation (slow), one variant at a time
styles.usage: Italic notes and figure captions (7.5 pt). ink-muted. The 'classical route' line under a problem card.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bold inline lead-ins and process-step numbers (7.5 pt bold). Same colour as the text it leads.

styles.name: cell-head
styles.usage: Matrix header cells, on-dark on ink-navy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a kicker and its title; between a step title and its description.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked rows; padding inside a legend chip; icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gutter between cards and tiles; card padding on dense slides.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between title block and content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a problem card, its arrow and the step stack; between slide sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap under the title block before diagrams.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left, right and top inset of the 960x540 slide (0.4 in). Nothing but a full-bleed figure crosses it.

tokens.name: disc-sm
tokens.usage: Step-number and icon disc inside a StepStack row.

tokens.name: disc-md
tokens.usage: Icon disc in a StepStack with icons; stage disc in ProcessFlow.

tokens.name: disc-lg
tokens.usage: Big-letter disc (FAIR tiles).

tokens.name: hub
tokens.usage: Diameter of the dark hub in a CycleDiagram.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Table cells, legend chips, process-step chevron corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, step rows, tiles, 'why it matters' bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The problem card and other full-height panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Discs and pills: step numbers, icon holders, the cycle hub.

layout.note: The slide canvas. The deck is 10 x 5.625 in; at 96 px/in that is 960 x 540, which every preview and token size assumes.

tokens.name: slide-w
tokens.usage: Slide width. Previews render components at this width or in a column of it.

tokens.name: slide-h
tokens.usage: Slide height.

tokens.name: content-w
tokens.usage: slide-w minus two slide-margins: the width every component lays out within.

tokens.name: rule-w
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table grid, dashed 'moving forward' outline (dashed 1px amber-700).

tokens.name: stroke-w
tokens.usage: Diagram strokes: cycle ring, connector lines, active-step outline.
